description: Get the unified ownership breakdown for a company, combining Form 4 insider holdings, 13F institutional holdings and 13D/13G activist positions, resolved across the three form types into one view. allHolders is paginated via limit/offset (default 100); aggregate stats (institutional / insider / beneficial totals and percentages, plus `retail`) are always complete. `sharesOutstanding`, the denominator of every percentage, is dated by `sharesOutstandingAsOf` + `sharesOutstandingAsOfKind` ("stated" = issuer's statement date; "checked" = last confirmed against a vendor; "none" = date not recorded) and `sharesOutstandingSource`; a count is only meaningful with its date. `retail` is the unattributed residual (shares no filing accounts for, including recent offering buyers and non-filing holders): an upper bound on retail, not a retail count; withheld (null) with `retail.reason: "filed_exceeds_outstanding"` when counted filings exceed shares outstanding. A bucket whose shares exceed shares outstanding by more than a 2% timing tolerance has `percentOfOutstanding` withheld (null, `percentWithheldReason: "ownership_exceeds_outstanding"`) with `totalShares` still published (e.g. another share basis such as ordinary shares vs ADSs, another class, lent shares reported twice, filings predating a buyback); the shares and the reason are the measurement, and the withheld percent is not 100%, 0% or any other percent. In that case `retail.reason` is `ownership_exceeds_outstanding` and `filedSumPercent` is absent. A null percent with no `percentWithheldReason` means no share count was available. `beneficial.staleShares` / `stalePercentOfOutstanding` / `staleHolderCount` is a measured subset of the counted 5%+ total resting on 13D/G schedules >= 24 months old with no newer reaffirming filing by the holder family: not a deduction. `reaffirmedBy` names the newer filing; `staleFiling.ageMonths` marks a row with none. `stalePercentOfOutstanding: null` is not measurable, not zero.

limit.description: Maximum holders to return in allHolders (default: 100, max: 100)

name: get_ownership
title: Get Comprehensive Ownership
